text:
Olivia Chen: Heads-up — PM just asked for a concrete plan for v1->v2 deprecation. They want minimal user disruption, clear telemetry, and a path to remove the v1 runtime in ~9 months. Thoughts?

Raj Patel: +1 on timeline. We need a compatibility shim option and a migration telemetry pipeline before announcing.

Maria Gonzalez: Agree. Two critical things: (1) exact semantic diffs between v1/v2 (streaming, chunking, default params) and (2) a quota/usage translation so customers don't get surprised billing-wise.

Sam Lee: Can we do an automatic routing layer that rewrites v1 API calls to v2 format? e.g. header `X-RW-Compat: v1` or a proxy that maps params. That would buy time.

Hiro Tanaka: Proxy shim is doable but has costs: extra latency and complexity for KV cache handling. Need perf numbers. Also some v1 behaviors (like implicit `stop` handling) are intentionally different; automatic rewrite may change outputs.

Olivia Chen: Good point about outputs. We should make the default shim opt-in per-project in Console, not global, until we verify quality. Console banner + one-click compatibility toggle. :warning:

Raj Patel: For quotas: translate v1 token units -> v2 tokens and show a preview for 7 days. Implement conservative mapping: if v2 charges differently for streaming chunks, show projected spend and a delta.

Maria Gonzalez: Telemetry: emit a deprecation metric `api.deprecation.v1.request` with tags {project, route, compat_enabled:true|false, rewrites_applied:true|false}. Hook alerts if >1% of traffic uses v1 after N days. Also log sample request/response diffs for quality evals (hashed user ids).

Sam Lee: Example shim rule (rough):
```
if header X-RW-Compat == 'v1':
  map param `prompt` -> `input`
  rewrite stream frames to v1 chunking
  preserve `n`/`temperature` semantics
  forward to model variant v2-compat-legacy
```
This would let us route to a compatibility-tuned model.

Hiro Tanaka: We should avoid routing to the same high-capacity production pool; use a capped autoscaler for compat pool to control cost. Also add a fallback policy: if compat pool overloaded, either (A) fail fast with clear 426/upgrade-required, or (B) route to pure v2 and mark as `compat_mismatch`. Which do we prefer?

Maria Gonzalez: Prefer (A) for correctness during early phase, (B) could silently change behavior and blow up tests. For large customers we can allow (B) as opt-in.

Olivia Chen: UX notes for Console: show a per-project "compatibility window" timeline, toggle, expected cost delta, and a small audit of routes that will be rewritten. Add an explicit checkbox: "Allow behavioral fallback to v2 when compat pool unavailable" with tooltip.

Raj Patel: Also need an API-level header for clients to opt out of rewrite: `X-RW-No-Rewrite: true` so SDKs can assert strict mode. We should document SDK migration guides.

Sam Lee: For rollout: canary the shim on 5% of internal traffic, run our eval harness (prompt suites) and compare outputs via BLEU/Diff heuristics + human spot checks. If regression rate < threshold, expand.

Hiro Tanaka: Ops: add a new trace attribute `compat.rewrite=true/false` and surface in per-route latency dashboards. We'll want percentile deltas.

Maria Gonzalez: Billing mapping: create a migration-preview API that returns {project_id, current_v1_spend_estimate, projected_v2_spend, delta_reason} for last 30 days. Useful for account teams.

Olivia Chen: Security/compliance: make sure compat pool can be pinned to Dedicated or Private for customers with data residency needs — they shouldn't be forced onto shared compat pool.

Sam Lee: Implementation tasks: 1) proxy shim + header rules, 2) compat model variants + capped pool, 3) telemetry metric + traces, 4) console toggle + migration-preview, 5) SDK header + docs.

Raj Patel: I'll draft an RFC with rollout phases and SLOs. Can we get perf estimates from infra in 2 days? @Hiro?

Hiro Tanaka: I'll run a bench with synthetic v1 traffic and post numbers. Expect ~15-40ms extra p50 depending on rewrites.

Maria Gonzalez: QA: add end-to-end tests that hit compat toggles and verify behavior parity for 200 sample prompts per model. We'll flag divergences.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: compat-proxy/feature-flag v0.1 -> staging (started) :rocket:

Olivia Chen: Perfect. I'll include the console UX mock in the RFC. Thanks everyone — RFC due EOD Friday. :calendar:
